Master Policy No.: DG/GHS/2026/004567 | Certificate No.: DG/GHS/2026/004567/0042
SCHEDULE OF LIMITS AND CO-PAYMENTS

Sum Insured Type: Individual per Member | Sum Insured: ₹5,00,000 per Insured Person per Policy Year
Dependent parents: For Kamala Verma (dependent parent) the Sum Insured is capped at ₹3,00,000
Corporate Buffer: ₹25,00,000 for the whole group, available only with prior approval of the policyholder
Guaranteed Bonus: 5% of Sum Insured is added at each renewal irrespective of claims
Room Rent: Room rent is limited to ₹5,000 per day
ICU: ICU and ICCU charges are limited to 2% of Sum Insured per day, subject to a maximum of ₹10,000 per day
Co-payment: A co-payment of 10% applies on every claim of dependent parents (Kamala Verma)
Non-network co-payment: 20% of the admissible claim for treatment at a non-network hospital, for all Insured Persons
Co-payment for Vikram Verma: 10% on diabetes-related claims of Vikram Verma
Voluntary Deductible: An optional Voluntary Deductible is available for a premium discount; no Voluntary Deductible has been opted under this Certificate
Joint Replacement: up to ₹1,50,000 per joint
Air Ambulance: up to ₹2,50,000 per hospitalisation
AYUSH Treatment: fixed ₹25,000 per Policy Year
Domiciliary Hospitalisation: 10% of Sum Insured up to ₹50,000 per Policy Year
Organ Donor Expenses: up to ₹1,00,000
Hospital Daily Cash: ₹1,000 per day for up to 10 days per hospitalisation
Attendant Allowance: ₹500 per day
Maternity (Asha Verma only): normal delivery up to ₹60,000; caesarean section up to ₹80,000; maximum 2 deliveries
=== PAGE BREAK ===
GENERAL CLAUSES - CLAIM PAYMENT

7.1 Sub-limits. The following sub-limits apply per Policy Year: cardiac procedures up to ₹2,00,000; cancer treatment as per actuals up to the Sum Insured.

7.2 Surgery components. Surgeon and anaesthetist fees together shall not exceed 40% of the surgery package, and operation theatre charges are payable as part of the package.

7.3 Package rates. For procedures listed in the network hospital agreement, the network package rates apply and the claim shall be paid at the package rate irrespective of the actual bill.

7.4 Order of application. Sub-limits shall be applied first, then the co-payment, and then the deductible, on the admissible claim amount.

7.5 Room rent. Room rent is limited to the fixed amount stated in the Schedule of Limits and Co-payments for each day of hospitalisation.

7.6 Deductible. Where the Policyholder has opted for a Voluntary Deductible, it is applied per Policy Year on the claim amount.
